title: Javelin Forms of the Senior Hand
summary: Joins the basic throws to a first use of qi in the arm so the shaft flies farther and strikes harder.

title: The Qi-Backed Throw: Intermediate Practice
summary: Teaches the thrower to gather qi in the forearm before release and to keep a guard ready afterward.

title: A Treatise on the Heavy Javelin
summary: Covers the thick war javelin thrown short and hard to break shields and drop mounted men.

title: Notes on Throwing From Moving Ground
summary: Notes for throwing from a cart bed or a rolling deck or a slope while the footing shifts.

title: The Double-Handed Javelin: Thrust and Throw
summary: Teaches gripping the javelin in both hands as a short spear first and throwing it only as a last stroke.

title: Guard and Cast: A Skirmisher's Second Book
summary: A second book for skirmishers that adds a ready guard to every throw so the thrower is never left open.

title: Collected Drills of the Thrown Spear
summary: Gathers the daily drills a thrower repeats to keep the arm and hip and footwork sound at higher power.

title: Javelin Counter-Throw and Interception
summary: Teaches answering an incoming javelin or arrow by catching, turning or throwing it back before it lands.
